title: Macro template project configuration
description: Single source of truth consumed by scripts/apply-config.mjs.

$schema.description: Path or URL to this JSON schema (enables editor validation).

org.description: GitHub organisation or user that hosts the repository.

repo.description: GitHub repository name (used for the Pages base URL).

webapp.description: Whether to build/deploy the optional advanced web app.

hasButton.description: Whether the macro adds a control-panel button with a mode selector (Auto / RoomOS Only / MTR Only) so a demo can force the web app's look. Not every macro needs one.

defaultMode.description: How the web app is themed until someone picks a mode on the button (or always, when hasButton is false). Auto follows the device: MTR theme on an MTR device. RoomOS Only / MTR Only force one look.

showCalendar.description: Whether the web app's MTR home screen shows a room calendar (booked meetings from Bookings List) beside the action icons. When false the icons are centred on the screen.

buttonName.description: Label shown on the device home-screen button when hasButton is true, and the wizard's default button name. Falls back to "title" when omitted.
